caption: The image depicts a single object, which is a fire bucket with a round body that tapers towards a narrow base and has a thick, twisted handle attached at the top. The bucket appears to be made of a material resembling leather and is painted in alternating diagonal stripes of tan and dark green or black. On the front of the bucket, there is a circular emblem featuring a bald eagle with outstretched wings in gray and black, a blue shield on its chest, and holding an olive branch and arrows in its talons. The shield has red and white vertical stripes. Above the eagle, there are three stars on a blue background. Surrounding the eagle is text reading "R. K. of the United States" in black letters on a tan ribbon-like banner. There are also some smaller red decorative flourishes on the side. At the bottom of the front, more text reads "Rutter Germantown." The background of the image is plain white with no other objects present.
title: Fire Bucket
